editorial:
A. mansion with a pet baby tiger and a loyal assistant who does everything for you. That is the world of Una, a powerful music producer who is used to getting exactly what she wants. She is controlling and bold, but everything changes when she meets B, a cool and independent artist. Una doesn't just want B's talent for her record label; she wants B in her bed too. The vibe is tense and weird, showing you how power plays work when business and romance get mixed together in a messy way.

You will really enjoy the acting here because the tension between the two women feels real and awkward. The movie moves at a steady clip, though some parts might feel a bit slow if you prefer big action scenes. It is a great pick if you like character studies about people who are a bit broken inside. A. glamour.
endingExplained: The relationship between Una and B eventually falls apart because Una cannot stop trying to control every part of B's life. After a series of fights and power struggles, B realizes that Una's love is actually just another form of ownership. B chooses her freedom over the fame and money Una offers. The movie ends with B walking away from the toxic environment, leaving Una alone in her big house with her tiger.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves complicated relationships and music industry stories.
